nom: I Dew Care Cake My Day Hydrating Sprinkle Wash-Off Mask

avis.titre: smells just like a frosted cake
avis.texte: I love birthday cake scented anything, so I was really excited about this. It smells really good, the 'sprinkles' make the whole experience, and the consistency is thick but blends out like lotion. Your skin feels soft and hydrated after, too.

This product smells good and goes on nicely, the first time i used it I had no issues. The second time it made my skin break out in a painful dry rash around my chin and cheeks. Will not be using it again.
I'm loving this wash-off mask. It leaves my face feeling soft and hydrated. Bonus: it smells A-M-A-Z-I-N-G!!!

avis.titre: Cake My Day, Make My Day
avis.texte: I bought the Scoop Party pack and although i have not tried the other two masks, I am OBSESSED with the Cake My Day. I've used this a couple of times after a chemical peel mask to ensure hydration and it has been amazing to my skin… considering I suffer from mild eczema on my face. Trying to keep my face moisturized and free from flare ups can sometimes cause little pimples so with the chemical mask and this right after, I haven't had any issues. Not everything is for everyone and although I would deem this product gentle/hydrating I would still recommend testing this out in an inconspicuous area just based off of other reviews that indicated irritation.
I've repurchased this because I have incredibly dry skin but love to do full faces of makeup, so this mask helps your skin be less flaky for sure.

avis.titre: IT SMELLS GREAT BUT THAT IS THE ONLY GOOD THING ABOUT IT.
avis.texte: THE FIRST TIME I USED THIS I BROK OUT SO I GAVE IT TO MY SISTER SHE DIDNT LOVE THE PRODUCT. SHE THOUGHT IT WAS AMAZING BUT THEN SHE HAD VERY GREASY SKIN I ALWAYS THOUGHT HER SKIN WAS SUPER DRY BUT NOW IT LOOK AS GREASY WHEN SHE DIDNT WASH HER HAIR AND IT WAS DAY 17 FOR HER.

I decided to try out this mask because i love the matcha mood one. Every time i used this mask (4 or 5 times) I would break out in cystic acne. I thought it was another product doing it but finally realize this was the culprit. Kaolin sucks.

avis.titre: I've purchased this product and really like it.
avis.texte: This mask is not used to remove makeup. Makeup should already be removed because this mask should be applied to a clean, washed face. I leave it on for about 20 mins. The mask is removed with warm water in a circular motion. I like the way my skin feels once removed.
This smells SOOOO good and made my skin feel silky soft and hydrated!!!
I got this in store because I saw it on tiktok it's great! Smells like a birthday cake!
I love this brand. Never fails to make me feel silly, smell good, + feel good after using it.
Love this face mask I will definitely buy it again Just sometimes, it is very hard to wash off It also doesn't remove make up but otherwise I love this product

I'm honestly in love with this mask. I'm very stingy and picky with the face masks I use because i don't really see a difference but THIS!!! this is amazing. it hydrates my skin and smells really nice!!

I have dry skin, and after -30 weather rolled in, none of my fancy skincare could save me no matter how much I moisturized and how many masks I tried, I would wake up with dry, irritated, flaking skin. Until I remembered I bought this mask on a whim. It saved me. Within 3 days, my skin was moisturized and calm again, I will never go without this mask ever, and I dread the day social media discovers it, because it smells like vanilla cake. Love love love this stuff, like I said, it saved my skin.

avis.titre: MY FAVORITE MASK I'VE EVER TRIED
avis.texte: Okay so I have really dry skin and I got this product in a 3 pack with the matcha and berry mask from them. Before I tried it I thought it was okay but after my first use I fell in love! It's smells great and not too sweet, is very thick and feels great in my skin, and best of all, is insanely hydrating! The packaging is cute too which is an added bonus. This is the most effective mask I've ever tried.
I use this product once a week. It smells just like cake. After it's done my face is SO SOFT. I love these.

I have combo skin: oily on the t-zone, smooth on the cheeks. I received a sampler of this face mask in one of Ulta's Diamond Member Variety Samplers with a purchase. I thought, 'Okay, this smells nice and it will be fun to use up then toss the container.' From beginning to end, I love the product. The scent is exactly like warm, vanilla cake. It's a fresh-baked cake scent, not sugary or powdery smelling like frosting. The mask applies well, dries down nicely and washes away easily. It leaves my skin with a clean feel but doesn't dry it out or leave me with oil blots. It's gentle enough to use 3-4 times a week and works well enough with my combo skin that I, being someone who is a little more particular about my products (usually a Thomas Roth gal), have purchased two new full-sized products. I am prone to breakouts when trying new products. I didn't have enough in the sample size to use this more than three times, but I had enough to know my skin stayed balanced each time I did. I'll be bummed if they discontinue this product and happy if they "Cake My Day" by keeping it :)

The mask is very fun b/c of the packing, spatula, & sprinkles. I'm a sucker for packaging. I was worried the sprinkles were going to be abrasive, but they actually dissolve quickly. There is a very light cake scent & I don't mind it at all. I typically stay away from scents cause they irritate my skin, but this was ok. This mask is very thick though, so you will want to use a wash cloth or hop in the shower afterwards. My skin does feel softer after using it! My bf did it with me and said his face felt like an "Angel's butt".

I just had my first baby 12 months ago and wow… pregnancy and postpartum and breastfeeding have completely changed my skin. Im always so dehydrated and I completely neglect myself. I rarely wear makeup now and even my skincare routine is nonexistent. I bought this as a pick me up and as a way to get help my super dry and neglected skin. Wow… first of all. It made my skin feel soft, smooth and hydrated. It's exactly what I felt my skin needed. It feels so good on the skin and so creamy when I'm washing it off. Second, the smell is absolutely delicious. I just want to eat it. It's not overpowering but it's there. And it's so therapeutic to smell it. If you are dealing with dry, rough skin, this may be a great mask for you. I will definitely repurchase again. I love it so much.

avis.titre: I didn't notice much but it smells good lol
avis.texte: I used this whole jar, using it twice a week, but I honestly haven't seen any major changes to how my skin feels. it's kind of thick, and it may take a while to completely rinse off, and it leaves an unpleasant feeling on my lips afterwards. that being said, it IS cute, and it smells really good. It's very slightly cooling, and I can see the appeal, but it didn't do much for my normal to dry skin. :)

This is such an amazing mask! It makes my skin so soft after using and it doesn't dry it out. The scent is very light, smells like vanilla icing. If you're a person who doesn't care if fragrance is in a product then you'll love this even though it is very faint. Obviously if you're sensitive to fragrances don't get it. A very light weight mask, I can barely feel it when I use it.

avis.titre: Smells amazing and very adorable packaging!
avis.texte: Although the packaging is large, it's so cute, and I believe that it has adequate amount of product. If you get the silicone mask applicator and then rub the product into the skin, you'll learn that it lasts quite often actually. I usually leave it on for longer than recommended solely because I love the appearance of it and how it makes me skin feel. I totally recommend for times you want to pamper yourself!
Used it only once with very satisfying results. Will use it twice a week from now on.

I bought this during the sale and am so glad I did! Today we had a blizzard so my daughters and I did a spa afternoon and used this mask. The scent is amazing and it is super easy to apply and wash off. We all agree that our skin feels soft and refreshed. This is a super fun mask especially if you're looking for something gentle enough to use on your kids too.
My daughter absolutely loves it. Her and her friends do it together for girls nigjt
My favorite mask, hydrating, good for sensitive skin, cooling, and it smells amazing! The packaging is beyond adorable, even down to the sprinkles in the face mask itself.
My face feels so soft after using this. I use it a few times a week before bed.
This mask smells so good! Just like a birthday cake! I actually got this for my birthday! The packaging is very cute and my face feels nice and hydrated! I actually love wearing it! 😜😜🤪
this mask is really cute and smells very good but for me it didn't do anything and it's kinda hard to wash it all off so i won't be buying it again

I was excited to try this after reading the reviews but was pretty disappointed. It had a chemical smell and didn't really do much even after several uses. The "sprinkles" are a cute idea though. Won't be purchasing again.
I have only tried this on my forearm and it didnt cause any irritation. The 'sprinkles' breakdown when you rub them around and it washes off well

I love this face mask, and I have very sensitive acne prone skin. This face mask made my skin glow, and made it feel so soft, and hydrated. It also smells amazing like a vanilla cake. The sprinkles add a nice touch, and it's a super cute concept. I have nothing bad to say about this face mask, and this is my own honest review, no one paid me to say this, and I wasn't sent it for free. I paid with this with my hard earned money. Thank you for reading! 😊❤️

avis.titre: don't buy if you have sensitive skin
avis.texte: Smelled great and looked great but it was tingling a little and when i took it off my skin was bubbling up. I don't have very sensitive skin but it made me break out.
The mask made me breakout. I thought it was something else but it was actually the mask. I wouldn't recommend to a friend.

I love how this smells. It's a cute and fun face mask to use as a pick me up. I got it as a birthday gift and I love it. It smells like vanilla cake and has cute "sprinkles" in it. It's also super hydrating. It leaves my face feeling moisturized.

They must have reformulated within the time that I last bought this, because what used to be a sweet, cake scented oasis from my eczema now not only doesn't smell anything like it used to, but also now irritates my skin, rather than soothing it
this mask is great i have SOOO sensitive skin and i thought this mask would be bad but i still wanted to try it anyways but it didnt hurt and left my skin moisterized!

This mask was lovely! I tend to have really dry and super sensitive skin, so I love when i find a product that doesn't give me any sort of reaction. This mask smells great, although I found it was easier to apply it with my fingers than to use the little spatula that came with it. It left my skin feeling hydrated and soft. This is for sure a new favorite for me!

I did like the scent of this mask. Smells just like a birthday cake. I did see that this mask left me with white residue. It definitely gave me a glow but not a good look lol so I would say pass it up.. I wouldn't recommend it.
This smells sooooo good and my dry skin loves it. Super hydrating!

Okay so I am a Hyram watcher, I know he doesn't really approve of this brand, but I wanted to try some of thier products anyway. HOLY AM I GLAD I DID. I purchased this mask for the winter because my skin gets awfully dry. It arrived yesterday and I tried it out. My skin feels sooooo soft and smooth!! LIKE IT FEELS AMAZING! 10000/10 RECOMMEND I LOVE IT!
I have very dry skin and this is the best hydrating product I have used that has effectively worked.

I've used this three or four times and haven't noticed a huge difference in my skin. It does smell nice and is fun to use, but as far as effectiveness, it may be more geared towards late teens or early 20's that just want the experience of a fun mask.

avis.titre: i think it made me break out
avis.texte: this mask does smell amazing and feels very good on the skin! it can cause break outs though so be careful
Super cute packaging, super moisturizing, love it all around.

This was just the right amount of hydrating for my skin, which is prone to becoming oily in my T-zone. Light, not too thick or greasy. My skin appears smoother, moisturized, and more even In tone after the mask. No breakouts with it! Most masks I've tried break me out instead of fix things. This is by far my favorite exception to that rule.

avis.titre: Watch out for the most scrumptious face mask! Love it
avis.texte: This is now my fav face mask 😂 just gotta watch out cause it makes me want cake baaaad

This smells soooooo good I just wish it was easier to put on. The consistency is different than most masks and it does not spread easily at all. I tried putting it on and every time I tried to spread it across my face it would just move with my fingers and not stay put.

avis.titre: If I could give this a NO star review, I would!
avis.texte: My 14 yr old used this twice in 3 days and had a chemical reaction to her skin. She was burnt very badly from the mix of ingredients in this product!

This is the first product review I've ever written. This mask works wonderfully on my skin. At 45 years old, I'm finding it difficult to find products that are just right. I like the fact that it doesn't dry on my face. Those type of masks dry my skin out. This one is very hydrating. I find the scent refreshing and light. I stood in my local Ulta debating for about 15 minutes whether to buy this product. I am so happy I decided to give it a try!

avis.titre: probably my fav i dew care mask!
avis.texte: this was hydrating and removed red spots from my face! it smells really good too! hyram also says nothing is too bad in this mask! i recommend the smaller version to see if u like it :)
I bought it in the mini pack awhile back and this was my favorite along with matcha mood! it's hydrating and leaves my skin looking amazing. it also smells GREAT.
It smells really good, however its kind of strange feeling, almost like a thin lotion. I havent seen any benefits from using it but it is fun and a cute experience
this mask was great and smells amazing but it did leave my face a bit red:/

avis.titre: I normally don't buy a lot of skincare but this is a must!!
avis.texte: This mask smells SO GOOD and it really does leave my skin so hydrated. It smells like vanilla cake and has little sprinkles in it which I don't mind.

This product is very nice because only one scoop can go a long way on your face. Although it is a bit thick, it leads to an easy application and overall, it leaves my combination skin feeling fresh, nourished, and hydrated.
Purchased for my 13 year old daughter and she is in love with this facemask.

This feels like a blanket of moisture when applied to the skin, not only that but this little container full of memories smells like a dunkaroo. Flash backs of yo-yos, snap bracelets, jelly shoes & HitClips are coming for you every time you open this little jar of rainbow parachute gym class fun & Saturday morning cartoons. Your skin will thank you & so will your childhood.

this face mask did me so well im a teen with acne and it hydrates as it says , it also makes pores seem smaller , and it leaves you with a glow once you wash it off . I would recommend to anyone with oily or acne prone skin + it's fun and cute packaging , would recommend!!!

avis.titre: I love it, it smells so good
avis.texte: As soon as you open the container it smells SO GOOD! It comes with an applicator. When I was putting the mask on it went on so smooth! It's easy to rinse off and leaves your face feeling amazing. I'm not sure if I got a small pimple from the mask or if it was already there and just now popped up!!

100% recommend this face mask. 1)it smells just like cake and it makes your skin very smooth. 2)Very easy to wash and it hydrates your skin!! Not only is this face mask amazing, but all of the others faces masks from idew care is amazing!!
I love this so much. The i dew care brand is so good for my face this mask is so great I can't take it.. lol, my skin is so dry and this helped moisture it it feels so soft and smooth.
I have only used this mask twice and in 1 week; I am pleasantly surprised at how nice my skin looks. Ive seen, already, an improvement in both tone and texture. Definitely reccomend this product.
I love to use this before I complete my morning skincare routine about once a week! It leaves my skin feeling super hydrated and soft! 10/10

Honestly, the best mask I've ever bought/used. Hydrated me without making me oily and I don't break out (which is rare) and it smells amazing. The sprinkles are a little jarring the first time but they're easy to get used to and this mask is amazing. I cannot day enough good things about it.

I've used it twice a week for two weeks now. it's a nice boost for the extra dry days. Definitely on the heavier side so it's a must for us dry skin queens. I'm ready for some of their other stuff. :))
I used the product a couple of times, it made my skin soft but because of the slight vanilla scent I got a big red pimple on my cheek.
good product, but you can get the scoop shop duo set, and get the same amount of product, PLUS a full sized makeup remover for only $14.
I got this for my birthday and I absolutely love it! Use your favorite moisturizer after and your skin will be GLOWING
If you are looking for a way to hydrate your skin, this is a pick me up you'll need! Very nice smelling and easy to apply to your face!

avis.titre: Who doesn't like cake to the face???
avis.texte: There's so much I love about this. The scent is amazing, I love that it looks like confetti frosting, very hydrating, just an all around fun mask. I have combo skin, I get dry patches around the nose and mouth area. I use this once maybe twice a week, depending on how much time I have.

I've been using this daily now for about a week and I love how gentle and hydrating this mask is!!! Not to mention, it smells like vanilla ice cream, so yummy. The little beads in the mask break down if you rub the same area for a couple of seconds, so they won't hurt the environment, yay! I definitely recommend this for anyone with dry skin :D
it smells like something i'd eat and while on it feels super cooling and relaxing

I first bought this just because I loved the cake batter smell. I put it on immediately when I got home, was confused when it didn't dry, and wiped it off with a damp cloth after 10 minutes. I didn't notice any results for the first few uses and decided it was just a moisturizer I was leaving on my face. Later on, I decided to try wetting my hands and rubbing it in after 10 minutes. I rubbed it in till the beads completely dissolved and holy mess, it worked! I started using it that way three times a week for my overly dry skin (I have eczema) and in just a week or so, saw amazing results. Currently on my third jar since last august. 😁

avis.titre: Notice a huge difference, in a GOOD WAY
avis.texte: I wanted to change my skin care routine but i didn't know how to. I knew wanted to get something hydrating, so when I went to my local Ulta and I came across this brand. I saw how cute the packaging was, especially since this has sprinkles in it. But i look at reviews and i notice a lot of people of like it. So when i finally got to try it, i notice a huge difference to my skin. Usually when i try a face mask, i don't feel anything afterwards but i felt hydration to my face and i felt it the next day. I notice a huge difference to my face! Ive never written a review but I'm glad my first review is something that i love so much.
Love this mask so much, it's so fun and produces amazing results. My husband even noticed how good my skin looked after I washed it off.
I have very dry skin and I'm always searching for something hydrating and this mask was amazing. Left my skin feeling hydrated and smooth and it smells amazing!
I received a sample of this in the store and it worked so well I had to get a full sized jar! I love the way my skin feels afterwards! So soft and your face will smell great!
Smells so good and feels nice! My skin was starting to dry out pretty severely as winter is coming and this was just the facial I needed to restore it! Love it

avis.titre: Smells good, but not really effective..
avis.texte: I was drawn to this product because I was looking for a good moisturizing mask and this one smells so good. It has sprinkles inside of it and smells really good. However, it does not moisturize very well. I would not buy this again.

I don't have sensitive skin, in fact I have dry skin-- but washing this off was really rough on my face! I've never had this sensation before! I thought it was kind of suspicious that it smells so good yet the beads weren't easily dissolved. nothing ever irritates my skin but this definitely did the job.
smells so delicious (sadly not edible though). makes skin refreshed and cool as soon as applied,smooth results and does exactly what it's supposed to do and more. couldn't love thos mask more.
smells just like cake! my face feels very soft and refreshed after using. will purchase again!
I enjoy this mask. It's soooooo much fun to use because of the sprinkles. This leaves my skin hydrated and glowy.
I love it for my skin type, but it may not be hydrating enough for dry skin.
Smells just like Birthday cake! Leaves my facial skin soft, moisturized and glowing.

I absolutely love the smell of the mask. It's so cute with the little sprinkles. I have really sensitive skin and rosacea, it's hard to find anything that doesn't irritate my skin. This was super refreshing when I applied it and left my skin amazingly soft and smooth after I removed it. I actually love that it doesn't dry down because I hate feeling so stiff with most masks. This is definitely my new go to mask and I can't wait to try more!

I got this in the mini scoop trio that I Dew Care offers and was so excited to try. It is a fun looking product and feels good on the face. I didn't really feel anything super hydrating, but my skin did feel soft after each use. I probably wouldn't purchase a full size though.

I love this mask! Definitely a new favorite. My skin feels super soft after and it smells amazing. I've used it 3x and I pack it on pretty heavy and I still have a lot left. I also like how the "sprinkles" aren't micro beads and they disintegrate into the skin!

avis.titre: very cute idea but not hydrating
avis.texte: i absolutely love the scent of it and the feel of it and the sprinkles and the little spatula. but after i rinsed it off (which took a while) my face was very matte-looking and did not feel hydrated or moisturized. ive tried many masks and many hydrating and moisturizing products and this is the first one that didnt work for me. my face is naturally glowy and it completely mattified my face, and normally with hydrating masks your face should feel immediately hydrated after the first use, but it actually seemed to do the opposite and dried out my face. i love this idea and everything about it except for the result with my skin and how long it took to rinse off. maybe changing the formula to make it penetrate deeper and add more ingredients that will thouroughly hydrate the face will do good for it.
this mask smells just like birthday cake icing! it's super fun and very hydrating! leaves my face feeling very soft. 100% would recommend.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: My face is both oily and dry. One side of my check is dry and have tried just about everything to keep it moisturized. Nothing seemed to work. I was excited to buy this. LET ME TELL YOU! after thr first use I was SHOOKED . I love the smell, the size and amount of product. A little goes a long way. Definitely recommend.

It's very smooth and feels cool and refreshing on the skin. It also smells great and has cute little sprinkles in it! However it's very hard to wash off and left my skin just as dry as it was before using this mask. So sad, the idea behind this mask is so fun :/

I love it! Really makes my skin feel hydrated and smooth. I have sensitive skin so this does not burn or hurt my face at all. Very cool and calm feeling. Its also very fun to smear this all over my face! Like I'm putting cake frosting haha!

I have really dry skin all over my face. Used this and when I put it on I literally said this is the most hydrating mask EVER!! And I've tried a lot! It also smells amazing and just feels so nice on the skin. Love it love it love it!!!

I have really dry skin all over my face. Used this and when I put it on I literally said this is the most hydrating mask EVER!! And I've tried a lot! It also smells amazing and just feels so nice on the skin. Love it love it love it!!!

Wow, super excited about this product! I suffer from very dry skin and my skin literally never felt better after just one use. I noticed immediate improvement on the textured areas on my face. It smells amazing, and is very cooling and refreshing. I will agree that you have to work a little bit to wash it off your face but it works so well that I will completely look past that.
I have pretty dry skin. I use the mask before bed, wash it off and put moisturizer on. When I wake up in the morning my skin feels so hydrated. My make up goes on a lot smoother too.
Only con is it's hard to wash off!!. Smells like heaven & does keep my face very moist!!. I literally wanna lick it off my face (Cake Batter Scent) would definitely buy this product again.

avis.titre: I love it so much!  Smells like heaven
avis.texte: I use this about 1-2 times a week and as soon as I wash it off I see such a huge change in my pores!! I have rosacea and usually big pores showing but this mask is so cooling it really helps. I totally recommend. It smells so good to!!

(Teen review) This product is great, I expected it to be very gimmicky and not do anything, but I was pleasantly surprised. I apply it all over my face two - three times a week and I genuinely have seen a difference. My nose has had super dry patches that even with moisturizer left my nose and upper lip looking like the aftermath of a sunburn. It also has seemed to improve the rosacea in my cheeks and chin. My eczema has not been negatively effected by this at all, even with the amazing smell. I'm not a huge fan of face masks in general but I absolutely love this. Also im in my mid teens and might get a pimple every two months so I can't attest to any acne solving properties of this but it hasn't increased or decreased pimples or bumps. Additionally I have been using this for about 8 weeks now and have seen a real improvement since the third or fourth time I used it.

Bought this outta of the blue! Cute packaging draws me in. I have dry and sensitive skin. A little hesitant to get it cause ever face mask I get always seems to burn me. Applying it went on smooth and smells delicious like CAKE! I had a bit of burning feeling but also cooling and heat. It felt ok I just fan it and it went away. Not an everyday use tho. Fun for once in a while. After using it I did notice my face being very smooth and hydrated! will buy as a gift for a family & friend. I'll also buy a mini one instead of full size next time.

avis.titre: Cute Gimmick, Doesn't Work As Well As I Hoped
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this mask, and although I wasn't ripped off, it doesn't moisturize my skin at all. The smell and look is great, and it definitely softened my skin and helped the texture a bit. The areas in which I'm very dry are still dry. However, I must just be unlucky because many other reviewers say it helped moisturize, haha! You get bang for your buck at least, I only needed less than a tablespoon's worth for one use. Great idea and I'll definitely use it again for fun, but I will have to continue my search on finding something that helps the dry issue with my skin.

This product smells AMAZING, I was so excited to use it. First con is, it is really tough to wash off, it's like trying to wash butter off your skin. Second is, unfortunately it did not work for my skin. After I washed it off my skin was extremely red and irritated. Really disappointed :/

avis.titre: Got this for Easter and I love it!!!
avis.texte: This is a super nice mask! I saw this in a makeup video and I wanted to try it out. I don't like peel off masks because they can be a pain to get off so I found out about wash off masks. The cake one stuck out to me the most and it smells just like cake frosting! I did see some reviews of it being hard to wash off and not working but I think it just depends on your skin. Other than that, I would highly recommend this if you are looking for a wash off mask! :D

So I bought this product after seeing it in a tutorial. When I applied it, it was very stingy, I should of known then that my skin was too sensitive to handle the ingredients. I left it on for the recommended time and washed it off. My skin felt super itchy and burnt the next day. I was so disappointed that my skin couldn't handle it. It smells so yummy and felt, at first, amazing.
Thought this was gonna be one of those products that was all hype, but I was so happy with the way it made my skin feel, and it literally smells good enough you wanna lick it or your face

This mask is a winner! It has a great texture, washes off clean. The beads are beautiful, and fun to use. The product feels luxurious. The scent is like heaven. I love how moisturizer my skin feels post mask.

This mask is amazing! It smells slightly like vanilla/cake and it looks super cute! Love the fact they included a little applicator as well! I kept touching and feeling my face after rinsing it off because my skin felt so incredibly smooth. At first I thought the jar seemed small but even after a very generous layer all over my face I would say I only used about 1/8th of the jar. Would recommend this to anyone!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I love how it literally smell like cake. Then the little bead inside the mask. It's so cute! I wouldn't mind buying this product again.

I've used so many masks in the past but this one takes the cake! (literally!) i never leave reviews but my face feels so hydrated and plump that i just had to let everyone know. it smells great too which is a bonus!

avis.titre: Not for daily use for dry skin
avis.texte: I love the smell of it dont get me wrong but to leave me face hydrated I didnt notice the difference and I have dry skin. I would just use it if I feel like pampering myself.

avis.titre: Left my parched skin feeling refreshed
avis.texte: I loved the way this mask left my skin. I felt hydrated, and smooth. It definitely improved my skin after just one use.
Such an amazing product​! Could not be happier! I have combo skin and I would use this at night and my skin would wake up with a beautiful glow!
